yourNature_desc: You are the jewel after refinement, small and exact, with more light than its size allows. You run level, with as much Metal coming in as you spend. Since no excess drives you, you need your own reason to count a piece finished. Each time you choose to stop at good or keep going toward your best. You pay for balance in deciding, because no part of you ever makes the call for you.

self_card.face: Polished, and set where it shows
self_card.presence: You run steady and give full care where you choose rather than everywhere. You make that call many times a day, and each one spends a little of your ease.

_trace.yourNature_desc: Balanced Metal gives no push either way, so the reader must supply the stopping point and pays in constant deciding.
_trace.self_card: the level state means care is chosen rather than spent everywhere, and the choosing is the cost.
